description: This EOB holds an elective knee surgery with no prior authorization and an acupuncture visit past the plan's yearly visit limit. One surgery line's denial note gives no plan section, while the acupuncture denial, whose note points to the appeal rights section, is complete (a decoy). The report should state that the surgery line's note must name the plan provision the denial is based on.
